jobs.title: Implementation Manager - Care Management
jobs.location: United States · Remote including New York
jobs.why: Outstanding healthcare systems fit: end-to-end implementation, requirements gathering, workflow design, UAT, go-live, post-launch stabilization, executive reporting, process improvement, and cross-functional delivery across clinical, operational, and IT teams.
jobs.gap: The posting requires experience with technology implementation or systems configuration including AI. Emphasize hands-on workflow automation, system rollouts, troubleshooting, testing, training, and healthcare operations without overstating AI engineering depth.

jobs.title: Integrated Care Program Operations Manager
jobs.why: Excellent healthcare operations match spanning program implementation, Medicaid/managed-care operations, process improvement, change management, stakeholder alignment, training, operational risk, and performance monitoring.
jobs.gap: The role asks for four years of healthcare administration plus four years driving performance/process improvement in health insurance. Medicaid/managed-care exposure is relevant, but payer-side tenure may be lighter than ideal.

jobs.title: Platform Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Strong health-tech implementation role focused on complex enterprise software projects, cross-functional coordination, project planning, executive reporting, risk management, client engagement, and process improvement.
jobs.gap: Healthcare integrations and EHR familiarity are preferred. Emphasize healthcare workflow implementation, systems coordination, documentation, training, stakeholder management, and technical troubleshooting while being clear about EHR integration depth.

jobs.title: Digital Program Manager
jobs.why: Very strong healthcare-tech operations role involving digital product implementations, client coordination, cross-functional work with Product, Engineering, Analytics and Operations, process improvement, project execution, and data-informed decision making.
jobs.gap: The role values analytics tooling such as Power BI/Tableau and data-platform exposure. Lead with reporting, Excel, workflow automation, healthcare operations, implementation coordination, and systems fluency without overstating BI-stack experience.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager Senior
jobs.why: Strong healthcare implementation and operations role leading project plans, workstreams, client communication, training, implementation milestones, and cross-functional deployment of workforce/VMS solutions.
jobs.gap: The role prefers demonstrated healthcare implementation ownership and proficiency with Smartsheet plus some ServiceNow exposure. Emphasize project tracking, Teams/Excel, onboarding, training, workflow implementation, and healthcare operations.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Strong healthcare technology fit covering full-cycle implementations, workflow optimization, training, configuration, data migration, stakeholder coordination, documentation, and system adoption.
jobs.gap: The role asks for roughly five years plus hands-on EHR implementation/integration experience. The salary ceiling only modestly clears the target, and EHR configuration depth is a stretch area.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager - Utilization Management
jobs.location: United States · Remote including New York
jobs.why: Healthcare transformation role with strong overlap in systems implementation, requirements, workflow design, testing, go-live, process improvement, reporting, and cross-functional delivery across clinical and operational teams.
jobs.gap: Utilization Management domain knowledge is less direct than Care Management, and the posting specifically calls for implementation/system configuration experience including AI. Treat as slightly more specialized than the Care Management opening.

jobs.title: Clinical Speciality Programs & Operations Manager - NY
jobs.company: Atria Physician Practice New York PC
jobs.why: Direct healthcare operations role involving referral funnels, scheduling conversion, operational KPIs, workflow optimization, staffing models, documentation, provider coverage, and cross-functional clinical program management.
jobs.gap: The role asks for five or more years in healthcare operations/clinical program leadership, strong analytics, Lean/Six Sigma exposure, and deeper EHR knowledge. It also requires five days per week onsite.

jobs.title: Marketing Campaign Operations Manager
jobs.why: Healthcare growth-operations option centered on CRM, marketing automation, workflow execution, Salesforce integration, data hygiene, QA, reporting, cross-functional handoffs, and process improvement rather than SEO.
jobs.gap: Hands-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud Account Engagement/Pardot experience is required, along with ABM and lifecycle campaign execution. This is a meaningful tool gap, so apply only as a targeted stretch using marketing-operations strengths.

jobs.title: Implementation Senior Manager - Clinical Intelligence
jobs.why: High-upside healthcare implementation role leading enterprise EMR rollouts, go-lives, stakeholder coordination, project timelines, testing, data governance, and collaboration across Clinical Operations, Product and Engineering.
jobs.gap: This is a senior stretch requiring 7+ years plus strong technical fluency with FHIR, HL7, REST APIs, and concurrent EMR implementations. Do not overstate healthcare IT integration depth.
